final: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.recordvault) FROM orders AS o2 JOIN orderexecutions AS e2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS fraction_of_orders FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase ORDER BY o.orderbase IS NOT NULL, o.orderbase
